thread:
maria.design: Heads up — on the Private setup wizard I found a tab/focus weirdness between the CIDR and Instance ID fields. When CIDR shows an error, tabbing cycles back to the Instance ID and it never moves forward. Tried twice. :confused:
ashley.prod: Thanks — which browser/os? Any screenshots?
raj.platform: Repro on Firefox 115 and Chrome 116 on Ubuntu. No console stack traces. Looks like when the validation message appears we recreate the input node and the focus gets lost in the react tree.
leo.devex: That matches a change we made to move inline error strings into the input key. If the key changes on error, React will mount a new node and focus doesn’t persist.
maria.design: Screenshot uploaded — arrow shows focus stuck. Also copy issue: label says "Hostname" but other places call it "Instance ID" and the inline helper uses "name" — inconsistent. We should pick one.
ashley.prod: Product preference is "Instance ID" for on-prem flows. Helps distinguish from cloud hostnames. Keep "Hostname" only when we truly mean DNS names.
raj.platform: Agree. Implementation note: keep stable element key based on field id "instance-id". Don’t base on error text.
leo.devex: For accessibility, add aria-describedby linking to the helper text and set the live error container to role="alert" so screen readers get immediate error announcements. Also ensure the helper text has an id that never changes.
maria.design: Proposed helper copy: "Instance ID (optional). Letters, numbers and hyphens. Used in logs and debugging."
ashley.prod: Trim further: "Instance ID (optional). Letters, numbers, hyphens. Shown in logs." Keep simple for setup flow.
raj.platform: Also proposing we change the inline CIDR error to a concise hint: "Invalid CIDR — expected format 10.0.0.0/16" with a small "Examples" chevron that expands details. Full KB remains available but buried for advanced troubleshooting.
leo.devex: I’ll add CSS for high-contrast focus rings: `@media (forced-colors: active) { .input:focus { outline: 3px solid WindowText; outline-offset: 2px; } }` and keep the theme variable fallback.
maria.design: Can we also verify keyboard order for the whole network step? On my keyboard run-through the subnet mask helper is after the submit button which breaks linear flow.
raj.platform: Good catch. I’ll adjust the DOM order so inputs and help are siblings before the next button. Also will write unit tests that assert tab order for the step.
ashley.prod: Please include acceptance criteria: 1) no focus trap in tab flows, 2) screen reader reads errors on change, 3) label updated to "Instance ID", 4) helper copy updated, 5) CIDR inline error short with Examples panel. Mark P2.
leo.devex: I’ll open a small PR for the CSS and aria changes. Raj, can you own the key stabilization + tests? Maria, can you update the figma and paste the exact copy in the ticket?
maria.design: On it. I’ll also add a small keyboard flow gif to the ticket showing repro.
ci-bot: Ticket created: INF-7632 "Instance ID focus trap & setup-step copy harmonization" — assignees: raj.platform, leo.devex, maria.design.
ashley.prod: Thanks everyone. Move to in-progress once PRs linked.
leo.devex: Will add a11y assertion in e2e and tag the PR with the axe run results.
maria.design: Done — filing the ticket now and attaching screenshot + gif. :thumbsup:
